import pytest

from jf import rules


def test_frac_equal_to_half_is_not_degenerate():
    # A null that keeps exactly half the aircraft-seconds is documented as real,
    # so it must participate in the rule checks.
    cands = [(100.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), (10.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]
    nulls = [
        {"kind": "shift", "verdict": "nothing", "best": 20.0, "frac": 0.5},
    ]

    out = rules.evaluate(cands, nulls, residual=5.0, support=[50.0, 40.0, 30.0])

    assert out["null_best"] == 20.0
